title: Remove unused type: ignore comments in airflow-ctl
body:
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
     https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0 -->

`mypy --warn-unused-ignores` — exposed to contributors as
`SHOW_UNUSED_MYPY_WARNINGS=true prek run mypy-airflow-ctl --all-files` — reports three
stale `# type: ignore` comments in `airflow-ctl`:

- `src/airflowctl/api/operations.py:221` — `[union-attr]`
- `src/airflowctl/api/operations.py:224` — `[union-attr]`
- `src/airflowctl/api/operations.py:228` — `[attr-defined]`

`execute_list()` leaves `data_model` untyped, so mypy already infers `Any` and these
suppressions no longer cover any error.

**Verification (run locally):**

- `prek run mypy-airflow-ctl --all-files` → passed
- the same check with `--warn-unused-ignores` → no findings left in `airflow-ctl`
- `breeze run --python 3.11 … mypy` (same invocation as the CI static-check job) → passed
- `ruff format` / `ruff check` → passed

The unused-ignore scan also lists 11 ignores in
`task-sdk/src/airflow/sdk/definitions/decorators/__init__.pyi`, but those only look unused
when the stub is followed from `airflow-ctl`; the task-sdk hook needs them, so they are
intentionally left untouched.

No runtime behaviour changes.

-                return data_model.model_validate(raw)  # type: ignore[union-attr]

         self.response = self.client.get(path, params={**shared_params, "offset": offset})

-        total_entries = first_pass.total_entries  # type: ignore[attr-defined]

             return first_pass
         found_key = None
